title: Path Traversal in Archive Extraction leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite
vulnerability_type: Arbitrary File Overwrite via Directory Traversal

security_impact.prerequisites: Victim application unpacks an untrusted archive containing parent directory traversal paths.

safe_reproduction.expected_behavior: Extractor validates canonical destination path and returns an error when entry escapes destination root.
safe_reproduction.observed_behavior: Extractor resolves path relative to working directory, writing outside designated extraction root.

root_cause.summary: Path canonicalization check was omitted before filesystem write operations in the unpack loop.

suggested_mitigation.compatibility_notes: Maintains backwards compatibility for all standard relative archive paths strictly within destination root.
